title: One sin and a thousand
odia:
ଚୋରି କଲା ଲୋକର ଏକ ପାପ
ଚୋରି ଗଲା ଲୋକର ସହସ୍ର ପାପ।
literal_meaning: The person who stole has one sin; the person who was robbed has a thousand sins.
meaning_odia: ଚୋର ଚୋରି କରି ଗୋଟିଏ ପାପ କଲା। ଯାହାର ଚୋରି ଗଲା, ସେ ବିନା ପ୍ରମାଣରେ ଅନେକ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦୋଷ ଲୋକଙ୍କୁ ସନ୍ଦେହ କରି ଅନେକ ପାପର ଭାଗୀ ହେଲା। ଏକ ଓ ସହସ୍ର ପାପର ତୁଳନା ଅମୂଳକ ସନ୍ଦେହରୁ ସାବଧାନ କରେ। ଚୋରିର ଶିକାର ହେବା ନିଜେ ଦୋଷ ନୁହେଁ; ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦୋଷଙ୍କୁ ସନ୍ଦେହ କରିବା ଏଠାରେ ନିନ୍ଦିତ।
explanation: The thief commits one wrong by stealing. The person robbed then suspects many innocent people and multiplies the wrong through groundless suspicion. The stark contrast warns against letting a loss turn into indiscriminate accusation; being robbed is not itself a fault.
usage_example: Original imagined example: After a theft, rumours name many people without evidence. Someone quotes the couplet to caution against spreading suspicion to everyone nearby.
cultural_context: The near-matching କଲା and ଗଲା switch the perspective from the person who acts to the person who loses. ଏକ and ସହସ୍ର then enlarge the reversal through a stark numerical contrast.
